Games/KnicksatCavaliers
Knicks 109Cavaliers 97

Brunson and Towns take Cleveland

Final · Sat, Nov 7 · Cleveland

Brunson scored 31 and Towns 29. New York led by as many as 19.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · First half

How it started.

The Cavaliers led 27–26 after one quarter. At the half, the Knicks led 63–53.

2 of 5 · The difference

Brunson: 31 points, 18 in the second quarter

12 of 25 from the floor, with 9 assists.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the second quarter 37–26

Down 1 after one quarter, the Knicks won the second quarter 37–26 to lead 63–53. Brunson and Towns combined for 60 of 109.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it on the glass and on second chances

Second-chance points 26–8; rebounds 49–40. N.Y. made 13 of 14 free throws.

5 of 5 · Final

Knicks 109, Cavaliers 97.

From the Cavaliers’ side: Lost the second quarter 26–37, the stretch that decided it.

What it meant: Knicks 6–5, 5th in the East, 61% top-6 odds. Cavaliers 6–6, 6th in the East, 64%.
